taskRule: Take one task with dependencies closed; attach actual diff and evidence. Do not infer a task passed from this plan.

tasks.title: Reproduce baseline and bind source identity
acceptance: Serve over HTTP; visit all seven views.
Same data release preserves 53 tambons,59 LAOs,290 register records and baseline tier/queue outputs.

tasks.title: Identity and basemap regression
acceptance: Favicon/social preview is readable and contains no uncleared coordinate or face.
Switch basemap preserves analytical fills, selected area, criteria, overlays and keyboard workflow.
Provider failure retains list and neutral fallback.

tasks.title: Resolve actual production entrypoint and shared modules
inputs: active production repository AGENTS and START_HERE
acceptance: Identify actual shared engine/source release/nav/map interfaces by exact commit.
Keep energy metrics/lenses mode-specific; do not import F&B assumptions.
Record formula mismatch before implementation; do not silently unify quantile methods.
tests: Review actual source imports and active contracts

tasks.title: Version source releases and evidence values
acceptance: Every metric retains unit,grain,source,asOf/readOn,measure kind,release and denominator.
Null,suppressed,not_yet,out_of_scope and unverified stay distinct from observed zero.
Cross-city comparison requires compatible schema/release or visible incompatibility.

tasks.title: Server workspace authentication and role permissions
inputs: Owner count override only: Admin1/Editor2/Viewer2; exact Yolk role permissions from full-product.v1.9.13.json $.production.rbac
acceptance: Anonymous cannot read private workspace or media.
Viewer cannot perform shared writes or Apply; self-only draft is permitted. Editor is workspace scoped.
Server derives actor and role; client supplied IDs never grant rights.
Exactly 5 authorized accounts have counts Admin1/Editor2/Viewer2; never derive roles from Drive/Sheet permissions.
Inherit Yolk permissions exactly, changing only role counts; preserve last Admin.
Viewer self-only preview/draft permitted, but never Apply/shared writes/new ShareGrant or widening audience.
Editor retains branch/target/evidence/media CRUD, scoped criteria Apply and permitted sharing; Admin adds workspace/members/custom-field management.

tasks.title: Shared shortlist with safe migration
acceptance: Preview migration and preserve legacy records; missing provenance remains explicitly incomplete.
Use expectedRevision to reject stale writes and idempotency key to avoid duplicate mutations.
One accepted mutation creates one audit event and durable outbox event.

tasks.title: Reviewed coordinate import in private workspace
outputs: approved import receipt or blocked gate list
acceptance: No import until owner decision closes applicable gates and current destination values match the approved plan.
Address-inferred identity needs office confirmation.
Internal import and public coordinate release remain separate decisions; keep fieldVerified false unless field evidence exists.
tests: Reject stale destination and duplicate record
Reject missing rights evidence for public projection

tasks.title: Field outcomes and protected media
acceptance: Record observedAt,actor,evidence and outcome; do not recast model estimates as field observations.
Private object cannot be fetched anonymously; signed URL expiry is not consent.
Rights withdrawal removes public projections on next governed release.

tasks.title: Office pilot and production release decision
acceptance: Office acceptance is documented; no adoption claim before evidence.
Physical device/screen reader gates recorded separately from browser simulation.
Source -> provider terminal success -> live bytes -> release attestation all bind same source.
tests: Live source/asset parity and rollback rehearsal
